integrity: The numerical checker tests finitely many primes and is not used as a proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes p an odd prime at least five, and does not address composite moduli or other unions of curves.
The Fourier-ratio formula applies to the spectral-set indicator only; weighted spectral-synthesis best constants are not claimed.
The exact finite-prime norm formula requires a one-dimensional absolute-character sum; absolute publication priority is not independently established.
title: A sharp \(4/\pi\) amplification law for Fourier projection onto two opposite finite parabolas
